raw.rationale: Tirapazamine is a hypoxia-activated DNA-damaging prodrug that requires low oxygen to generate cytotoxic radicals, so at 2.5 µM in standard adherent PRISM culture it should show little selective killing except in lineages with intrinsically high hypoxia or reductase expression. Published PRISM/CTRP data indicate minimal lineage selectivity, with only small-cell lung cancer and some CNS lines occasionally showing modest sensitivity.
